competitors.name: U.S. grocery retail
competitors.action: Supermarket News reported Bain and NielsenIQ findings that U.S. grocery units fell 1.8% year over year in June after dropping about 2% in most months since February. Bain said 80% of Americans are trying to cut spending, with grocery retailers now competing in a share game where value, promotions and private brands matter more.

competitors.name: U.S. grocers and frozen aisle
competitors.action: Grocery Dive reported that June Circana data showed shoppers reduced fresh produce purchases while buying more frozen fruits and vegetables; fresh produce prices rose nearly 5% year over year while frozen fruits and vegetables rose 2%. The signal is that value pressure is pushing some demand toward frozen formats.

competitors.name: Wakefern Food Corp.
competitors.action: Supermarket News reported that Wakefern will remove synthetic dyes and additional ingredients from Bowl & Basket food and beverage products by January 2027 across banners including ShopRite, Price Rite Marketplace and The Fresh Grocer. The move extends clean-label pressure deeper into mainstream private label.
